title: 30L Double-Acting Double-Speed Dough Mixer 170118
description: Item number: 170118 The 30L double-acting double-speed dough mixer is a new dough mixing machine. The mixing arm and the mixing barrel rotate at the same time, so that the mixing speed is increased, and the mixing efficiency is improved. The dough mixer is equipped with a protective cover so that the safety can be improved. The dough mixer is attractive in appearance, easy to operate and good in safety, and is suitable for mixing flour in hotels, resturants and so on. Product Parameters Mixing Barrel Capacity: 30L Voltage: 110V 60Hz Power: 2.2KW Maximum Dry Flour Capacity: 12KG (26lb) Mixing Speed: 168/252R/Min Weight: About 79KG (174lb) Size: 28.35''x15.75''x30.78'' (72x40x78cm) Barrel Diameter: 16.93'' (43cm) Barrel Depth: 10.24'' (26cm) Product Features 1. The motor is the heart of the machine, the 100% copper motor have good power, the long-term operation of the machine can be ensured, and the service life of the machine is prolonged. 2. When the protective cover is lifted, the mixer automatically stops, safe operation is ensured, and the user is prevented against accidents. 3. The fast speed and the slow speed can be freely chosen to meet different speed requirements. 4. The user can choose the automatic modes with the speed from the fast speed to the slow speed and from the slow speed to the high speed, and set the time for slow and fast operation. Once the time is up, the mixer will automatically stop running. 5. While the mixing arm rotates, the mixing barrel rotates, so that the dough is more uniform. 6. The barrel making contact with flour is made of stainless steel, and is safe and healthy. The protective cover is made of stainless steel, the mixer can automatically stops when the protective cover is lifted, the user is effectively protected, and accidents are avoided. The fast speed and the slow speed can be freely chosen to meet different use demands, the automatic modes with different speed processes can be freely chosen, and the time can be set. Once the time is up, the machine will automatically stop running. The mixing barrel is made of stainless steel which is hard and durable, and the safety and the health are guaranteed. The multi-hole design is adopted on the back of the machine body, heat is effectively dissipated, and the motor temperature is effectively reduced. Operation Methods The dough mixer is connected to a power source, the emergency switch is turned on, the stop/start button is pressed, the timing button is pressed, and then the user can choose the following modes: (1) if the user wants to mix flour at a fast speed for 3 minutes: the timing button is pressed, the fast speed lamp lights up, the right display window flickers, the time value can be set to be 3 through the "+" button and the "-" button, then the fast speed buttton is pressed, and the machine starts to run. (2) if the user wants to mix flour at a slow speed for 6 minutes: the timing button is pressed, the slow speed lamp lights up, the left display window flickers, the time value can be set to be 6 through the "+" button and the "-" button, then the slow speed buttton is pressed, and the machine starts to run. (3) if the user wants to mix flour in an automatic mode with the fast speed for 3 minutes and the slow speed for 6 minutes: the timing button is pressed, the timing lamp lights up, the left display window is set to be 6, the timing button is pressed again, the right display window is set to be 3, the automatic button is pressed, then the automatic mode choice lamp lights up, the mode button is pressed to choose the high to low mode immediately, the machine starts to run.
